name: 132. List models pagination returns each model once (#7760)
description: Issue #7760: ApplyPagination reset to offset 0 when a provider's live listing shifted between page requests, so /v1/models re-emitted the first page (duplicate rows) and skipped rows after the reset point. The case pages through the Hugging Face listing with a small page_size, following next_page_token, and asserts every model id appears exactly once and pagination terminates. Live upstream drift is what triggers the pre-fix failure, so the deterministic pin is the Go unit tests in core/schemas/models_test.go; this case is the end-to-end check that the wire output has no duplicates.
